lyrics:
[HOST INTRO: STATIC BURST, MECHANICAL CLICK, DIAL TONE SWEEP] [SPEED 180 BPM] [TIME 7/8 METER] [HOST VOICE: TRASHY BROADCAST AMPLITUDE, HOARSE URGENCY] Caller zero-four, you are live on the page-wheel frequency! State your coordinate before the carrier wave shears your ribs into footnotes! [CALLER 1: HIGH-PITCHED RADIO-WAVE ENTITY, DISTORTED CARRIER BUZZ] What is going on! The nightclub floor is turning sideways like a wet cardboard box! My sensors are bleeding into the bass bins! [HOST LAUGH: BRASSY, CHEAP VAUDEVILLE HORNS STAB] Ha! That is just the wildlife migration through the coat check, citizen! You humans always confuse lateral page-rotation with territorial dispute! Let us take another transmission from the hold queue! [SUDDEN TAPE STOP, MECHANICAL CRUNCH, CROWD MURMUR IN ALIEN DIALECT] [VERSE 1: RAPID CABARET PATTER, UPRIGHT SLAP BASS, DISTORTED SAX STABS] Attention specimens in sector nine! The carpet has teeth and it requires your spine! Do not look at the ceiling grid! The numbers are counting backward and hiding what they did! Keep your knees bent! Keep your jaw tight! The radio waves are eating the light! [CHORUS: MASSED DOO-WOP HARMONY, STOMP-CLAP GROOVE, MICROTONAL BRASS] What the fuck is going on! The page-wheel turns and the station is gone! We are signals trapped in a copper wire! Singing our songs while the speakers catch fire! Doo-wop wop! The circuit is dead! Somebody spilled the floor on my head! [HOST INTERRUPT: BELL DING, FEEDBACK SQUEAL] Hold! Put caller seven on hold! They are leaking semantics into the transmitter! Let us check the microwave oven in the green room! Is the wildlife still mating with the toaster? [WILDLIFE NARRATOR INTERLUDE: DRY, CLINICAL FIELD-DOCUMENTARY DELIVERY, TICKING CLOCK] Observe the human subject under aberrant salience. It notes the precise micro-wrinkle in the vinyl flooring. It assigns a theological weight to the number three. It refuses to blink until the radio signal bends. A classic territorial display of a species that does not know which page it occupies. [VERSE 2: HOCKETED VOCAL FRAGMENTS, CRUSHED PIANO, ASYMMETRIC 7/8 DRUM PULSE] Left foot, right foot, slip through the crease! Nobody moves until the static police release the carrier wave! Feel the salvia page-wheel spin! Where does the caller end and the radio begin? No one knows! No one cares! We are broadcasting blind down the elevator shafts of the stars! [BRIDGE: SLOW MOTION DECAY, TAPE SPEED DROPS, SUB-BASS DRONE, WHISPERED POLYPHONY] The room is folding like a napkin in a hurricane. Every memory you have ever had is being transcribed by a blind beetle. The radio tower is made of wet teeth. Can you hear the dial tone? Can you hear the floorboards breathing? [CALLER 2: PANICKED FALSETTO SCREAM, BRASS EXPLOSION] The nightclub is spinning! The drinks are made of old geometry! My signal is clipping through the walls! [HOST LAUGH: DERANGED, CHEAP CASSETTE SATURATION] Relax, caller! That is just the normal municipal procedure! Nobody gets out until the rating improves! [GUITAR SOLO: FRANTIC GARAGE-ROCK SCRATCHING, DISTORTED SAXOPHONE FEEDBACK, HIGH KINETIC VELOCITY] [OUTRO: RAPID CADENCE, HORNS BLARING, DIAL TONE RISING TO PIERCING SHRIEK, SUDDEN VOLTAGE CUT]
